model_spec.mask32: mask32(0) = 0xffffffff (width-32 wrap, verified on the single live f5=0 point); mask32(f5>0) = 2^f5 - 1
model_spec.p_table: P0(f5,flag) = (0xc|flag) & mask32(f5): f5>=4 -> 0xc/0xd; f5=3 -> 0x4/0x5 (flag=1 unobserved); f5=2 -> 0x0/0x1; f5=1 -> 0x0 (flag=1 unobserved); f5=0 -> 0xc/0xd (flag=1 unobserved)
model_spec.f5=2_note: flag=1 deposits 1<<idx; the bclr-of-idx reading coincides on all three captured points (rs bit idx was set each time); axis f5=2 idx=5 stays OPEN per the fuzz-5 ruling (modeled + validated only, no semantics change)
model_spec.operand_dependence: rogue values move with rs because rs survives outside the mask (OPDEP-A/B captured shape); the deposit itself is rs-independent

meta.static_rule: H-34-rt-fed iff >= 3 strict sites with a live rt def (contradiction of the const-deposit model); else H-34-field-consistent when strict sites exist; no strict sites -> null (silent static leg). H-34-field-consistent means NO rt-fed contradiction was detected -- it is the absence of a contradiction signal, not positive corroboration of the deposit value (offline def-use cannot see the deposited constant). A residual raw rt_live signal (1..2 sites) on a merge-candidate row is adjudicated per-row offline (see rt_live_adjudication_rule), not silently thresholded away
meta.residual_rule: contradiction in any leg (live mismatch or static rt-fed) -> row model_form = residual
meta.addressing_note: dc offsets only; no dc<->rt base arithmetic needed (per-section param0 bases live in corpus_sections.json)
meta.model_form_note: formula: the uniform P-model fits every captured observed value; rows with an any-leg contradiction keep their prediction but are itemized as residual
meta.rt_live_adjudication_rule: owner ruling 2026-11-01 (final-review round 2): a merge-candidate row (live match, no conflict) with a raw rt_live counter-signal below RT_FED_MIN carries a per-row offline adjudication of EVERY rt-live site (decoded def-use window: rt producer, the 0x34 site, rd consumers, rt forward liveness). noise = concrete non-rt explanation (another consumer of rt / rt dead at the site / dead rd / cross-function or self-aliasing artifact) keeps the row mergeable; real = rt's value would flow into rd's consumers -> conflict -> residual; a missing or incomplete adjudication also fails closed (unadjudicated -> residual). Rows at/above RT_FED_MIN keep their H-34-rt-fed residual status (not un-residualed).
meta.ruling_note: fuzz-5 owner ruling «ось f5=2 idx=5 не трогать» EXCLUDES the axis from any merge-ready claim (select_merges.py OPEN_RECS precedent): the fuzz-4 V-34-2 observation (rs=0xff, rt=1 -> 0x000400ff, census_map OPEN-34-f5=2-idx=5) contradicts the P-formula and is outside fuzz5_live.json; excluded rows carry ruling_excluded + ruling_note
meta.extras_note: disc-extra records (family-level live_verdict:"rogue" assigned by T3 at build_live_table.py:529) are joined by their captured VALUES only; the family tag is not used by the model or the join
meta.unblocked_note: rows with no contradiction in either leg (live match + static not rt-fed), MINUS the ruling-excluded OPEN axis keys (ruling_excluded_rows); merge-candidates with a raw rt_live signal below RT_FED_MIN carry rt_live_adjudication (noise-with-reason per site; anything less fails closed to residual, see rt_live_adjudication_rule)
